dedupe_keys.name: nordicdat cross border predictive quality of service dataset finland sweden norway

description: NordicDat is a mobile network quality-of-service and mobility dataset collected by driving measurement campaigns near the borders of Finland, Sweden and Norway, published in April 2024 by Topi Miekkala, Pasi Pyykönen and Georgios Drainakis for research on predictive quality of service and roaming. It has more than 90,000 samples from LTE and 5G radio access networks with physical-layer values (RSRQ, RSRP, RSSI, SINR), band, serving cell and anonymised operator, network delay and service status, uplink and downlink throughput, and vehicle kinematics (location, elevation, heading, speed and acceleration), mostly at highway speeds. Coverage: border regions of three Nordic countries, one campaign. Format and access: one CSV file of about 14 MB on Zenodo; free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: limited routes and dates; operators are anonymised; throughput depends on the test device and server. Simulation uses: service performance baselines and training data for predictive QoS, handover and roaming models used in capacity planning and in resilience studies of connected transport. Related records: Ookla open data and M-Lab give broad performance measurements, and the 5G handover simulator models handover algorithms.
